note: The three-way identity rule shared by ONB shared-utils/interview_completion.py prompt_status and the Command Center src/lib/interview/state-identity.ts classifyStateIdentity (BU-35). NONE of the three stamps present is legacy (the Command Center calls it unstamped); a present stamp that differs, or only some stamps present, is mismatched. Only mismatched refuses the interview link.

cases.name: legacy: no identity stamps, no declaration
matched: all three stamps present and equal, no declaration
mismatched: all three present, one differs
flag true: interviewComplete answers COMPLETE over a mismatched identity
